jobs.title: Email Content Strategist
jobs.description_text: As an Email Content Strategist on the Grassroots Editorial Team, you'll help Americans for Prosperity (AFP) develop compelling email campaigns that engage grassroots audiences, advances policy priorities, and inspire people to take action. In this role, you'll write and edit high-impact grassroots emails, including advocacy campaigns, newsletters, lifecycle communications, and event promotions. You'll also collaborate with our Growth, Marketing, and Lifecycle teams to develop content calendars and identify opportunities to improve audience engagement and campaign performance. This role requires 3+ years of professional writing experience in political communications, public policy, or grassroots advocacy, along with a strong understanding of email marketing and audience engagement. You should bring excellent writing and editing skills, sound editorial judgment, an analytical mindset, and an entrepreneurial approach to turning organizational priorities into action. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $75,000–$100,000 per year.

jobs.description_text: Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000–$100,000 per year.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Mexico & Central America
jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com

jobs.title: Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Are you passionate about breakthrough technologies and eager to shape the future of satellite-based solutions for defence and national security? We are seeking a Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist to help shape new satellite-enabled capabilities for Canadian and allied defence users. Reporting to the Director, Research & Development, Defence Satellite Mission Solutions, you will lead multidisciplinary investigations from mission-need qualification through initial prototype laboratory validation. Initial opportunities include system features such as alternative positioning, navigation and timing (PNT), optical relay connectivity with other satellite systems, and space-domain awareness data products. You will combine technical depth with systems thinking, practical experimentation and multidisciplinary leadership.

This role will provide technical leadership for the implementation and integration of security capabilities within CI/CD pipelines, including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), software supply-chain security, vulnerability management, artifact integrity, and code signing. Working within the Engineering DevSecOps team and closely with the CI/CD Architecture Lead, the Senior DevSecOps Security Engineer will partner with development teams to embed security controls into engineering workflows, strengthen secure development practices, and support the remediation of vulnerabilities identified through automated tooling. The role will also collaborate closely with Telesat Cybersecurity and Compliance teams to translate security policies, standards, and control requirements into practical, automated engineering controls.

jobs.description_text: The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.
